strings.zh: 乔伊『现在回头还不晚哦{VAR:0103:0},{NEWLINE}火箭队现在已经势不可挡,{CLEAR}很快就能统治整个地区。{CLEAR}只要加入我们,{CLEAR}将来这片土地上的所有人和精灵{CLEAR}都可以随你驱使,{CLEAR}请不要再犹豫了！
strings.en: Joy: {VAR:0103:0}, it’s not too late to turn{NEWLINE}back.{SCROLL}Team Rocket is unstoppable now, and{NEWLINE}soon we’ll rule the whole region.{SCROLL}Just join us, and one day every person{NEWLINE}and Pokémon in this land will obey you.{SCROLL}Please, don’t hesitate any longer!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『让我像你们一样{NEWLINE}高高在上欺压别人？{CLEAR}抱歉我做不到！{CLEAR}坂木和达马兰奇主席{CLEAR}还有精灵联盟的官员们{CLEAR}都在前面的四天王房间吧？{CLEAR}我现在就去打败坂木救出他们,{CLEAR}彻底粉碎你们的阴谋！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Lord it over others and crush{NEWLINE}them like you do?{SCROLL}Sorry, I can’t do that!{SCROLL}Giovanni, President Goodshow and the{NEWLINE}League officials are all in the Elite{CLEAR}Four’s rooms ahead, right?{SCROLL}I’m going to beat Giovanni right now,{NEWLINE}rescue them, and crush your scheme{CLEAR}once and for all!

strings.zh: 小豪『乔伊小姐,早就跟你说了{NEWLINE}这个王八蛋不识好歹。{CLEAR}不要在他身上浪费时间了,{CLEAR}跟我一起干掉他！
strings.en: Goh: Miss Joy, I told you ages ago.{SCROLL}This bastard doesn’t know what’s good{NEWLINE}for him.{SCROLL}Stop wasting time on him and help me{NEWLINE}take him out!

strings.zh: 小豪『乔伊小姐,早就跟你说了{NEWLINE}这个王八蛋不识好歹。{CLEAR}不要在她身上浪费时间了,{CLEAR}跟我一起干掉她！
strings.en: Goh: Miss Joy, I told you ages ago.{SCROLL}This bastard doesn’t know what’s good{NEWLINE}for her.{SCROLL}Stop wasting time on her and help me{NEWLINE}take her out!

strings.zh: 乔伊『唉,该说的话我都说了。{NEWLINE}如果你还是不肯回心转意,{CLEAR}那我也不必再心软,请乖乖去死吧！
strings.en: Joy: Sigh... I’ve said everything I had{NEWLINE}to say.{SCROLL}If you still won’t change your mind, I{NEWLINE}don’t need to go easy on you anymore.{SCROLL}So please, be a dear and die!

strings.zh: 小豪『不可能……{NEWLINE}我拥有6只传说中的精灵,{CLEAR}怎么会输给你！？{CLEAR}不可能,一定是哪里搞错了,不可能……
strings.en: Goh: No way... I’ve got six Legendary{NEWLINE}Pokémon!{SCROLL}How could I lose to you?! No way, there{NEWLINE}must be some mistake. No way...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『别犯傻了小豪,{NEWLINE}你刚刚使用的传说中精灵,{CLEAR}跟我在冠军之路看到的一样,{CLEAR}都只是用传说中精灵的能量{CLEAR}制造的幻影罢了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Don’t be stupid, Goh.{SCROLL}The Legendary Pokémon you just used{NEWLINE}are the same as the ones I saw on{CLEAR}Victory Road.{SCROLL}They’re just phantoms made from{NEWLINE}Legendary Pokémon’s energy.

strings.zh: 小豪『什么！？{NEWLINE}你说坂木老大送给我的精灵,{CLEAR}都是虚假的幻影？
strings.en: Goh: What?!{SCROLL}You’re saying the Pokémon Boss Giovanni{NEWLINE}gave me are all fake phantoms?

strings.zh: 小豪『喂,乔伊,这家伙说的是真的吗？{NEWLINE}你们火箭队说好要帮我集齐图鉴,{CLEAR}结果拿幻影耍我是吗？
strings.en: Goh: Hey, Joy, is what this guy said{NEWLINE}true?{SCROLL}Team Rocket promised to help me{NEWLINE}complete my Pokédex, and you’ve been{CLEAR}jerking me around with phantoms?

strings.zh: 乔伊『像你这种反复无常的小人,{NEWLINE}如果不是因为有个抓精灵的特长,{CLEAR}坂木老大看都不会看你一眼。{CLEAR}你竟然还妄想得到{CLEAR}火箭队好不容易抓来的传说精灵,{CLEAR}你也配？
strings.en: Joy: A fickle little weasel like you...{SCROLL}If you didn’t have a knack for catching{NEWLINE}Pokémon, Boss Giovanni wouldn’t even{CLEAR}glance at you.{SCROLL}And you actually dreamed of getting the{NEWLINE}Legendary Pokémon Team Rocket worked{CLEAR}so hard to catch?{SCROLL}You? As if you deserve them.

strings.zh: 小豪『敢耍我？我弄死你！
strings.en: Goh: You played me? I’ll kill you!
{VAR:0103:0}: Stop, Goh!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『就算你现在{NEWLINE}跟火箭队撇清关系,{CLEAR}也掩盖不了你曾经帮助火箭队的事实。{CLEAR}如果你想将功抵过,就老实告诉我{CLEAR}火箭队在前面四天王的房间里{CLEAR}有没有布置什么陷阱,{CLEAR}如果我进去救人质,{CLEAR}有没有需要注意的地方。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Cutting ties with Team Rocket{NEWLINE}now won’t erase the fact that you{CLEAR}helped them.{SCROLL}If you want to make up for it, tell me{NEWLINE}straight.{SCROLL}Has Team Rocket set any traps in the{NEWLINE}Elite Four’s rooms ahead?{SCROLL}Anything I should watch out for when I{NEWLINE}go in to save the hostages?

strings.zh: 小豪『好,既然火箭队对我不仁,{NEWLINE}就别怪我不义了。
strings.en: Goh: Fine.{SCROLL}If Team Rocket’s going to screw me{NEWLINE}over, they can’t blame me for turning{CLEAR}on them.

strings.zh: 乔伊『哼,叛徒,老大果然没有看错。{NEWLINE}跟你搭档真是我的耻辱！
strings.en: Joy: Hmph, traitor. The boss was right{NEWLINE}about you all along.{SCROLL}Being partnered with you was a{NEWLINE}disgrace!

strings.zh: 小豪『闭嘴吧你,我现在在帮精灵联盟{NEWLINE}消灭你们火箭队,{CLEAR}我是伸张正义呢！
strings.en: Goh: Shut up. I’m helping the{NEWLINE}Pokémon League wipe out Team{CLEAR}Rocket now.{SCROLL}I’m on the side of justice!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『少说废话,{NEWLINE}赶紧把你知道的情报告诉我。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Enough talk. Hurry up and tell{NEWLINE}me what you know.

strings.zh: 小豪『虽然我也很讨厌你这个冠军,{NEWLINE}但我现在更想报复火箭队。{CLEAR}下面我说的是我亲眼所见的情报,{CLEAR}你可给我听好了。
strings.en: Goh: I hate you too, Champion, but{NEWLINE}right now I want payback on Team{CLEAR}Rocket more.{SCROLL}What I’m about to tell you is what I saw{NEWLINE}with my own eyes, so listen up.

strings.zh: 小豪『火箭队启动了{NEWLINE}石英大会用的那种机关,{CLEAR}只要有一个人进入了四天王的房间,{CLEAR}入口通道就会立刻关闭,{CLEAR}以此保证每次房间里只有一个敌人。{CLEAR}这样无论来多少训练家,{CLEAR}房间里的干部们都可以逐一击破。
strings.en: Goh: Team Rocket switched on the{NEWLINE}system the Indigo Conference uses.{SCROLL}As soon as one person enters the Elite{NEWLINE}Four’s rooms, the entrance shuts.{SCROLL}So there’s only ever one enemy inside{NEWLINE}at a time.{SCROLL}That way, however many Trainers come,{NEWLINE}the Executives inside can pick them off{CLEAR}one by one.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『看来进入房间之后{NEWLINE}就要单打独斗了……{CLEAR}还有其他要注意的地方吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So once I’m inside, I’m on my{NEWLINE}own...{SCROLL}Anything else I should watch out for?

strings.zh: 小豪『从第一个四天王房间开始,{NEWLINE}每个房间里都有两名干部看押人质。{CLEAR}四天王房间和冠军房间{CLEAR}合计有10名干部。{CLEAR}坂木则是押着达马兰奇去了冠军殿堂。
strings.en: Goh: From the first Elite Four room on,{NEWLINE}two Executives guard the hostages in{CLEAR}each room.{SCROLL}That’s 10 Executives across the Elite{NEWLINE}Four rooms and the Champion’s room.{SCROLL}And Giovanni took Goodshow to the Hall{NEWLINE}of Fame.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这11个敌人{NEWLINE}每人身上至少有一只传说中精灵,{CLEAR}是这样吧？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So each of these 11 enemies{NEWLINE}has at least one Legendary Pokémon?

strings.zh: 小豪『那我就不知道了,{NEWLINE}我以为所有的传说中精灵都在我这呢。{CLEAR}结果全是假货！{CLEAR}这帮天杀的混蛋,真是该死！
strings.en: Goh: That I don’t know. I thought all{NEWLINE}the Legendary Pokémon were with me.{SCROLL}Turns out they were all fakes! Those{NEWLINE}goddamn bastards! They deserve to die!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『不要抱怨了,{NEWLINE}还有其他注意事项吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Quit complaining. Anything else{NEWLINE}I should know?

strings.zh: 小豪『最后还有一点,{NEWLINE}你进去之后的这一路战斗,{CLEAR}没有任何人会给你回复,{CLEAR}所以备齐了药品再往里进,{CLEAR}省得死在半路。
strings.en: Goh: One last thing.{SCROLL}Once you’re in, nobody’s going to heal{NEWLINE}you the whole way through.{SCROLL}So stock up on medicine before you go,{NEWLINE}or you’ll die halfway.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『没错,进入这里之后{NEWLINE}将是漫长的战斗,{CLEAR}我得好好准备一下才行。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Right. Once I’m in, it’s going{NEWLINE}to be a long fight.{SCROLL}I’d better get properly prepared.

strings.zh: 进入这里之后,便无法再返回了,{NEWLINE}途中也没有任何回复精灵的地方。{CLEAR}确定要进去吗？
strings.en: Once you enter, there’s no turning{NEWLINE}back, and there’s nowhere to heal your{CLEAR}Pokémon along the way.{SCROLL}Are you sure you want to go in?

strings.zh: 我这里是给火箭队员们回复精灵的,{NEWLINE}当然你如果肯交钱的话{CLEAR}也可以给你的精灵回复。{CLEAR}1万元回复一次,你要交钱回复吗？
strings.en: I heal Pokémon for Team Rocket members{NEWLINE}here.{SCROLL}Of course, if you’re willing to pay, I{NEWLINE}can heal yours too.{SCROLL}It’s $10000 a heal. Want to pay for{NEWLINE}one?

strings.zh: 有钱能使鬼推磨,{NEWLINE}我不管你是不是敌人,{CLEAR}只要你交钱我就帮你的精灵回复。
strings.en: Money talks. I don’t care if you’re the{NEWLINE}enemy.{SCROLL}Pay up, and I’ll heal your Pokémon.

strings.zh: 你这个联盟冠军连1万元都拿不出来,{NEWLINE}你还给达马兰奇打什么工啊,{CLEAR}加入我们火箭队算了。
strings.en: You’re the League Champion and you{NEWLINE}can’t even cough up $10000?{SCROLL}Why are you still working for Goodshow?{NEWLINE}Just join Team Rocket already.

strings.zh: 小豪『你进去之后的这一路战斗,{NEWLINE}没有任何人会给你回复,{CLEAR}所以备齐了药品再往里进,{CLEAR}省得死在半路。
strings.en: Goh: Once you’re in, nobody’s going to{NEWLINE}heal you the whole way through.{SCROLL}So stock up on medicine before you go,{NEWLINE}or you’ll die halfway.

strings.zh: 乔伊『你很强,但我仍然坚信{NEWLINE}坂木老大比你更强。{CLEAR}你向他挑战,就是以卵击石、自取灭亡。
strings.en: Joy: You’re strong, but I still firmly{NEWLINE}believe Boss Giovanni is stronger.{SCROLL}Challenging him is like throwing an egg{NEWLINE}at a rock.{SCROLL}You’re only destroying yourself.
